changeSet.author: Ahmed.Baz
changeSet.sql: create table accounts ( id bigint not null, account_type varchar(255) not null, account_number varchar(255) not null, constraint account_id_pkey primary key (id), constraint account_number_ukey unique (account_number) );
create sequence accounts_seq minvalue 1 maxvalue 999999999 increment by 1 start with 1 nocache nocycle;
